how_to_use: Type the market price you see for each contract into 'price' (power in GBP/MWh, gas in pence/therm), then Commit changes. A run starts automatically, compares it with our fair price and logs a paper trade if they differ by 2% or more. Only the first price entered for a contract counts, and it must be entered before delivery starts. Keep the quotes and commas exactly as they are; leave null to skip.

power_month 2026-11.what: UK baseload power, 2026-11 (e.g. ICE UK Base Load futures)

gas_month 2026-11.what: NBP gas, 2026-11 (e.g. ICE UK NBP futures)

power_quarter 2027-Q1.what: UK baseload power, 2027-Q1 (e.g. ICE UK Base Load futures)

gas_quarter 2027-Q1.what: NBP gas, 2027-Q1 (e.g. ICE UK NBP futures)
